title: Cohen-Macaulayness of squarefree powers of edge ideals of whisker graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with edge ideal $I(G)$. For $q\ge 1$, the $q$-th squarefree power $I(G)^{[q]}$ is generated by products of $q$ pairwise disjoint edges of $G$. It is the Stanley-Reisner ideal of a simplicial complex $\mathsf{MF}^q(G)$, called the $q$-matching-free complex, whose faces are those subsets $F\subseteq V(G)$ for which the induced subgraph $G[F]$ contains no matching of size $q$.
